packageRules.description: Effect v4 ships under the 'rc' dist-tag, not 'latest' (which still points at the v3 line), so Renovate would otherwise never see a v4 update. Grouping keeps effect and every @effect/* package on a single version in one PR, across the root package and each project under tests/ -- they must match or the generated code fails to typecheck. Switch followTag to 'latest' once v4 is stable.
